title: Body Doubling for ADHD: How to Try It Today (and the Apps That Help)
summary: Body doubling for ADHD uses a quiet companion to make focus easier. Learn why it works, how to start, the best apps, and when to seek ADHD support.
body_markdown:
## When to Seek ADHD Support


Body doubling is a low-risk strategy, and the research behind it is still emerging. A[2025 EEG study](https://doi.org/10.1145/3663547.3759743) of 26 adults found no measurable negative effects from body doubling and pointed to promising gains for unmedicated participants with ADHD, such as fewer distractions and faster task completion. It can be a genuinely helpful tool, but it is not a substitute for professional care, and it helps some people and some tasks more than others. When focus problems, missed deadlines, or the emotional weight of falling behind start interfering with work, school, or relationships, it is worth talking with a qualified clinician.


For anyone still figuring out whether ADHD is the right explanation, an accurate[ADHD evaluation](https://lifestance.com/services/adhd-testing-evaluation/) is the foundation for any plan. Evidence-based[treatment for ADHD](https://lifestance.com/services/adhd-treatment-options-therapy-medications/) often combines approaches such as[cognitive behavioral therapy](https://lifestance.com/services/cognitive-behavioral-therapy/) , skills coaching, and, when appropriate,[medication](https://lifestance.com/services/adhd-medication-management/) . Deciding how to approach[balancing ADHD medication and therapy](https://lifestance.com/blog/balancing-adhd-medication-therapy/) is a conversation to have with a provider.


If you were[recently diagnosed with ADHD as an adult](https://lifestance.com/blog/recently-diagnosed-with-adult-adhd-here-are-your-next-steps/) , a LifeStance[therapist](https://lifestance.com/provider/therapist/) can help you build a plan that fits your life.
